create_mlm_loss_criterion: create an MLM loss criterion by instantiating NoNSPBertLoss with args and task objects
run_mlm_loss_forward: run the forward method of NoNSPBertLoss to compute masked language model loss for a given model and sample
aggregate_logging_outputs: aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training using NoNSPBertLoss.aggregate_logging_outputs
register_mlm_criterion: register the NoNSPBertLoss class as the 'mlm_loss' criterion via the register_criterion decorator
test_mlm_loss_computation: test the MLM loss computation by calling forward with a model, sample containing net_input and lm_target tensors
